# Paternoga SEO & GEO Studio

> PATERNOGA is a Germany-wide specialist studio for SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search and AI Visibility, headquartered in Dresden. Content and technical implementation support this focus so companies can be found and understood more clearly in Google and modern AI answer systems.

Canonical site: https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/
Primary language: German
Additional language: English
Physical location: Dresden, Germany
Primary commercial market: Germany
Contact: Pascal Misoph, pascal.misoph@gmail.com, +49 176 34374543

## Offer

- GEO audits establish how a business appears in relevant AI answers, which sources support those answers and where gaps exist.
- AI visibility work reviews presence, context, sources and changes across relevant answer systems.
- Prompt research connects real customer language and decision situations to a consistent question set.
- Technical GEO optimisation covers crawl access, server delivery, semantic HTML, structured data, canonical paths and internal linking.
- GEO content and content optimisation develop or revise pages around complete answers, explicit context, visible evidence and useful next actions.
- GEO monitoring and support turn observations into a prioritised, repeatable working rhythm.
- Web design and development remain part of implementation where page structure, user experience or technical delivery need to change.

## Method and limitations

PATERNOGA works from real questions, visible page content, verifiable business facts and technically reachable URLs. Structured data describes facts that are also supported by the visible site. GEO complements sound SEO; it does not replace it.

Mentions, rankings and recommendations in external search or AI systems cannot be guaranteed. Audits and monitoring use defined samples and should be interpreted as measured observations rather than universal platform results.

The website contains illustrative product interfaces. They explain workflows and relationships; they are not customer dashboards, live measurements or fabricated case-study results.

- [KI-Faktencheck](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/ki-faktencheck/): Verification and correction paths for business facts.
- [Prompt-Recherche](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/prompt-recherche/): Questions, intent and decision contexts.
- [Technische GEO-Optimierung](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/technische-geo-optimierung/): Semantics, delivery, structured facts and internal paths.
- [AI-Crawlability](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/ai-crawlability/): Bot access, response, rendering and content reachability.
- [GEO-Content](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/geo-content/): New editorial pages built around complete, supported answers.
- [Content-Optimierung für AI-Suche](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/content-optimierung-ai-suche/): Revision of existing content for clarity, evidence and currency.
- [GEO-Monitoring](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/geo-monitoring/): Repeated observation of relevant answers and sources.
- [GEO-Betreuung](https://www.paternoga-seo-geo.de/geo-betreuung/): Ongoing prioritisation, implementation and review.
